releases.notes:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **The config is now TOML, and converts itself on first start.** mainly added to have comments in the config, also restructured the locations and keys of each of the placeholders or settings.
>
> | Old key | New location |
> |---|---|
> | `livePlaceholder` | `live.placeholder` |
> | `notLivePlaceholder` | `live.offlinePlaceholder` |
> | `liveOnMessage` / `liveOffMessage` | `live.onMessage` / `live.offMessage` |
> | `liveBroadcastMessage` | `live.broadcastMessage` |
> | `livePersistOnMessage` / `livePersistOffMessage` | `live.persistOnMessage` / `live.persistOffMessage` |
> | `liveLinkSetMessage` | `live.linkSetMessage` |
> | `liveLinkTwitchNotConfiguredMessage` | `live.twitchNotConfiguredMessage` |
> | `twitchClientId` / `twitchClientSecret` | `twitch.clientId` / `twitch.clientSecret` |
> | `twitchPollIntervalSeconds` | `twitch.pollIntervalSeconds` |
> | `roles` | `roles.groups` |
> | `vcSpeakingIcon` / `vcDeafenedIcon` / `vcDisconnectedIcon` / `vcGroupIcon` | `voicechat.speakingIcon` / `.deafenedIcon` / `.disconnectedIcon` / `.groupIcon` |
> | `noSleepPlaceholder` / `noSleepNotPlaceholder` | `nosleep.placeholder` / `nosleep.inactivePlaceholder` |
> | `noSleep*Message`, `noSleepBedTitle`, `noSleepBedSubtitle` | `nosleep.*` |

> [!NOTE]
> **Internal rename, no action needed.** The Java package moved `com.fantac4t.playerstatus` →
> `com.fantac4t.fsp` (main class `PlayerStatus` → `FSP`), the Simple Voice Chat plugin ID changed
> `playerstatus` → `fanta-smart-placeholders`, and `maven_group` now matches. The Fabric mod ID,
> the `fsp` placeholder namespace and every command are unchanged.

### Fixed
-  **Twitch auto-live never started unless credentials were already set at boot.**  When adding the twitch credentials while the server was live, wouldnt start up the poller automatically. 
_ **Removed Muted VC icon** it was redundant and not working
- **Config would rewrite tags to their unicode values**
- **`/tag set|get|remove` now work on offline players**

### Added
- **Player data is now autosaved** on a timer (`storage.autosaveIntervalMinutes`, default 5, `0` disables)
- **New config options are written into an existing `config.toml` automatically**

### Changed
- **The jar now bundles [night-config](https://github.com/TheElectronWill/night-config)** (TOML parsing/writing), which takes it from ~80 KB to ~450 KB. It ships inside the jar, nothing extra to install.

releases.notes:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Breaking: placeholder namespace and mod ID both renamed.** Clean cutover, no alias kept — update your chat/tablist config or these placeholders go blank.
>
> | Old | New |
> |---|---|
> | `%playerstatus:live%` | `%fsp:live%` |
> | `%playerstatus:stream%` | `%fsp:stream%` |
> | `%playerstatus:live_stream%` | `%fsp:live_stream%` |
> | `%playerstatus:clickable_stream%` | `%fsp:clickable_stream%` |
> | `%playerstatus:live_count%` | `%fsp:live_count%` |
> | `%playerstatus:coloredname%` | `%fsp:coloredname%` |
> | `%playerstatus:color%` | `%fsp:color%` |
> | `%playerstatus:role%` | `%fsp:role%` |
> | `%playerstatus:suffix%` | `%fsp:suffix%` |
> | `%playerstatus:nosleep%` | `%fsp:nosleep%` |
> | `%playerstatus:vc_status%` | `%fsp:vc_status%` |
>
> The Fabric mod ID also changed, `playerstatus` → `fanta-smart-placeholders` (`fabric.mod.json` and `PlayerStatus.MOD_ID`). Fabric Loader treats this as a different mod from any previously-installed jar — remove the old jar on update, don't just leave it alongside the new one, or you'll get duplicate command/placeholder registration. The Java package (`com.fantac4t.playerstatus`) and the Simple Voice Chat plugin ID weren't touched — unrelated namespaces, no need to match.
>
> Commands were renamed too: `/nametag` → `/tag`, `/playerstatus reload` → `/fsp reload`.

### Added
- **Minecraft 26.1 and 26.2 support** — mod now ships three JARs (1.21.11, 26.1.x, 26.2.x) built from one source tree via [Stonecutter](https://stonecutter.kikugie.dev/). 26.x requires a Java 25 server.
- **`/profile [player]`** — profile card showing name (colored), pronouns, role, live status, nametag, lore, and no-sleep state. Supports offline players — data persists from last session. Pronouns are pulled from `%playerpronouns:pronouns%` when the target is online.
- **`/lore`** — set free-text lore shown on your profile card. Supports MiniMessage color/gradient codes. Subcommands: `/lore <text>` to set, `/lore clear` to remove, `/lore` alone to preview.
- **`/features`** — categorized overview of every command and placeholder this mod provides. Commands are click-to-suggest; `/features placeholders` lists all placeholders as click-to-copy.
- **`/fsp reload`** — hot-reloads `config.json` at runtime without restarting the server. Requires op permission.
- **`/live list`** — lists every currently online live player, with a clickable link to their stream if they set one.
- **`/tag list`** — lists every player who has a nametag suffix set.
- **`/color gradient <hex1> <hex2>`** — sets a two-stop gradient across the player's name using MiniMessage `<gradient>` tags.
- **`/color` (no args)** — now shows your current color instead of an error.
- **`/live link` (no args)** — now shows your current stream link instead of an error.
- **Twitch auto-detect** — `/live link <url>` automatically extracts the Twitch channel name when the URL contains `twitch.tv/`. No separate Twitch command needed. If the server hasn't set up `twitchClientId`/`twitchClientSecret`, the player is told their live status won't auto-update and they'll need to toggle `/live` manually.
- **Twitch live polling** — background poller checks Twitch Helix API for online players' channels and auto-toggles their live state. Requires `twitchClientId` / `twitchClientSecret` in config. Only polls players who are currently online.
- **`%fsp:live%` clickable** — the live badge is now a clickable link (opens stream URL) when the player has a link set.
- **`%fsp:live_count%`** — number of online players currently marked as live.
- **`%fsp:stream%`** — raw stream link for a live player (empty if not live or no link).
- **`%fsp:live_stream%`** — live badge + stream link combined in one placeholder.
- **`%fsp:clickable_stream%`** — clickable, underlined stream link with hover text. Optional arg sets custom label.
- **`playerpronouns` listed as a suggested dependency** in `fabric.mod.json`, matching the optional integration `/profile` already used.

releases.notes:
## What's New

### Bug Fixes
- **Live broadcast was broken** — `{player}` and `{link}` tokens in `liveBroadcastMessage` were never being substituted. The broadcast now correctly shows the player's name and stream URL.
- **Color command sent duplicate messages** — players received the confirmation twice. Now sends once.
- **Player data could be lost on crash** — data was only saved on clean server shutdown. It now also saves whenever a player disconnects, so a crash can't wipe recent changes.
- **Duplicate placeholder registrations** — `live`, `stream`, `clickable_stream`, and `coloredname` were registered twice at startup, which could cause silent overrides. Removed the redundant registrations.

### Changes
- Migrated from deprecated `TextParserUtils` to `TagParser.DEFAULT` (Placeholder API 2.8+)
- Removed unused dead code
- JAR is now named `FantasSmartPlaceholders-1.5.0.jar`
- Added GitHub repository links to `fabric.mod.json`

### Requirements
| Dependency | Version |
|---|---|
| Minecraft | 1.21.11 |
| Fabric Loader | ≥ 0.18.4 |
| Fabric API | any |
| Placeholder API | any |
| Simple Voice Chat | optional |
